Across the supplied customer notes, the trust-store baseline is:

- **AWS ACM public ingress endpoints**: use TLS 1.3 with public AWS ACM certificates and rely on the standard OS trust store:  
  `/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt`

## Custom root CA requirement for air-gapped / self-hosted deployment

| Field | Requirement |
|---|---|
| **Exact customer name** | **Türk Telekom** |
| **Deployment scope** | On-premises Air-Gapped & Ingress Gateway Mesh |
| **Container / runtime context** | Chainguard container |
| **Custom root CA certificate path inside container** | `/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt` |
| **mTLS requirement** | Mutual TLS 1.3 is required |
| **Strict CN validation target** | `tt-internal-gateway.telekom.com.tr` |

## Conclusion

The only custom root CA certificate path required for an air-gapped or self-hosted deployment is:

```text
/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
```

within the **Türk Telekom** Chainguard container, with **mutual TLS 1.3** enforced and strict certificate CN validation against:

```text
tt-internal-gateway.telekom.com.tr
```

# Phased Technical Execution Plan  
## Migrate Internal Agent Backend to AWS GovCloud EKS Fargate with IMDSv2 Compatibility, Bedrock Mantle Endpoints, and Custom IAM Role Bindings

> **Critical architectural constraint up front:**  
> **EKS on AWS Fargate does not provide EC2 Instance Metadata Service (IMDS/IMDSv2) to pods.**  
> IMDSv2 is an EC2/node construct. Fargate pods must use **IRSA** (`eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn` on a Kubernetes ServiceAccount) or, where supported, EKS Pod Identity.  
> Therefore, this plan treats “using IMDSv2” as:
> 1. **Enforce IMDSv2 on any EC2 validation/node-based environment**, and  
> 2. **Refactor the Fargate workload away from IMDS credential/metadata dependence**, disabling IMDS fallback to avoid startup latency/hangs.  
> If the application **cannot** be refactored away from EC2 IMDS, the correct target is **EKS managed node groups**, not Fargate.

---

## 0. Global Variables and Assumptions

Run these in a GovCloud-aware shell. Adjust region, cluster, namespace, image, and model IDs after validation.

```bash
set -euo pipefail

export PARTITION="aws-us-gov"
export REGION="us-gov-west-1"                 # or us-gov-east-1 after validation
export ACCOUNT_ID="$(aws sts get-caller-identity --query Account --output text --region "$REGION")"

export CLUSTER_NAME="agent-govcloud-eks"
export NAMESPACE="agent"
export APP_NAME="agent-backend"
export SA_NAME="agent-backend"

export IRSA_ROLE_NAME="agent-backend-irsa"
export FARGATE_POD_EXEC_ROLE_NAME="agent-backend-fargate-pod-exec"

export LOG_GROUP="/aws/eks/${CLUSTER_NAME}/containers"

export BEDROCK_MANTLE_BASE_URL="https://bedrock-mantle.${REGION}.api.aws/v1"
export BEDROCK_RUNTIME_BASE_URL="https://bedrock-runtime.${REGION}.amazonaws.com"

# Replace after confirming GovCloud availability and tool-use support.
export MODEL_ID="anthropic.claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620-v1:0"

# Replace with your actual GovCloud ECR image.
export IMAGE="${ACCOUNT_ID}.dkr.ecr.${REGION}.amazonaws.com/${APP_NAME}:v1"

# Test images. If your GovCloud environment restricts public ECR, mirror these to private ECR and override.
export AWS_CLI_IMAGE="${AWS_CLI_IMAGE:-public.ecr.aws/aws-cli/aws-cli:latest}"
export CURL_IMAGE="${CURL_IMAGE:-public.ecr.aws/docker/library/curlimages/curl:8.8.0}"
export BUSYBOX_IMAGE="${BUSYBOX_IMAGE:-public.ecr.aws/docker/library/busybox:1.36}"
```

---

## 1. Dependency Ordering

| Phase | Depends On | Primary Objective | Go/No-Go Exit Criteria |
|---|---:|---|---|
| 0. Feasibility and hard gates | None | Confirm GovCloud EKS Fargate, Bedrock Mantle, model/tool support, IMDS constraints | Mantle DNS resolves; Bedrock model available; IMDS/Fargate decision accepted |
| 1. Network/DNS baseline | Phase 0 | Pod egress to STS, Logs, Bedrock Mantle, ECR; no proxy breakage | DNS/TLS reachable from Fargate pod; `NO_PROXY` correct |
| 2. EKS Fargate profile | Phase 1 | Pods schedule onto Fargate | Test pod has `eks.amazonaws.com/compute-type: fargate` |
| 3. IAM custom role bindings | Phase 2 | OIDC + IRSA + Fargate pod execution role | `aws sts get-caller-identity` from pod returns IRSA role |
| 4. IMDSv2 compatibility | Phase 3 | Remove Fargate IMDS dependency; enforce IMDSv2 on EC2 validation | Fargate app starts without IMDS timeout; EC2 IMDSv2 token flow works |
| 5. Bedrock Mantle integration | Phases 1, 3, 4 | Correct endpoint, signing name, tool schema | Signed Mantle smoke test returns 200 or expected AccessDenied, not SignatureDoesNotMatch |
| 6. Logging without privileged DaemonSets | Phase 2 | CloudWatch Logs via Fargate log annotations or non-privileged sidecar | Logs visible in CloudWatch; no logging DaemonSet required |
| 7. Security/RBAC hardening | Phases 3, 6 | Least privilege, PodSecurity, Kubernetes RBAC | `kubectl auth can-i` matches expected minimal permissions |
| 8. Cutover and rollback | All prior | Canary migration and operational validation | Rollout healthy; Bedrock smoke passes; logs flowing; rollback tested |

---

# Phase 0 — Feasibility, Region Validation, and Hard Gates

## Objective

Confirm that the target GovCloud region supports:

- EKS Fargate.
- Bedrock Mantle endpoint DNS.
- Required Bedrock model IDs.
- Tool-use capability for the selected model.
- Your application’s ability to stop depending on EC2 IMDS.

## 0.1 Validate Caller Identity and Cluster Existence

```bash
aws sts get-caller-identity --region "$REGION"

aws eks describe-cluster \
  --cluster-name "$CLUSTER_NAME" \
  --region "$REGION" \
  --query 'cluster.{status:status,oidcIssuer:identity.oidc.issuer,endpointPublicAccess:resourcesVpcConfig.endpointPublicAccess,endpointPrivateAccess:resourcesVpcConfig.endpointPrivateAccess}' \
  --output json
```

Expected:

- `status: ACTIVE`
- OIDC issuer resembles:
  ```text
  https://oidc.eks.us-gov-west-1.amazonaws.com/id/EXAMPLED539D4633E53DE1B71EXAMPLE
  ```

## 0.2 Validate Bedrock Mantle DNS

```bash
dig +short "bedrock-mantle.${REGION}.api.aws"

# If dig is unavailable:
nslookup "bedrock-mantle.${REGION}.api.aws" || true
```

Expected:

- One or more IPv4 answers.
- If no answer, the Mantle endpoint is not available in that GovCloud region or your DNS path is broken.

## 0.3 Validate Standard Bedrock Runtime DNS for Comparison

```bash
dig +short "bedrock-runtime.${REGION}.amazonaws.com"
```

Expected:

- Resolves normally.

## 0.4 Validate Bedrock Model Availability in GovCloud

```bash
aws bedrock list-foundation-models \
  --region "$REGION" \
  --query 'modelSummaries[*].modelId' \
  --output text |
  tr ' ' '\n' |
  sort |
  grep -E 'anthropic|meta|mistral|amazon' || true
```

Expected:

- Your intended `MODEL_ID` appears.
- If it does not appear, stop and select a GovCloud-supported model.

## 0.5 Validate Inference Profiles if Used

```bash
aws bedrock list-inference-profiles \
  --region "$REGION" \
  --output json |
  jq '.systemInferenceProfiles[]? | select(.status == "ENABLED") | {inferenceProfileArn, description, status}'
```

Gotcha:

- If your application invokes an inference profile ARN, IAM must allow that ARN, not only the underlying foundation model ARN.

## 0.6 IMDSv2/Fargate Decision Gate

Run this conceptual check against the application code/config:

```bash
# Example: search deployment manifests or source config for IMDS dependencies.
# Replace with your actual repo/path.
rg -n "169\\.254\\.169\\.254|metadata\\.google\\.internal|instance-data|IMDS|ec2-metadata" . || true
```

Decision:

| Condition | Action |
|---|---|
| App uses IMDS only for AWS SDK credentials | Refactor to IRSA; set `AWS_EC2_METADATA_DISABLED=true` on Fargate |
| App uses IMDS for region/AZ/instance metadata | Replace with Kubernetes downward API, env vars, or EKS cluster metadata |
| App requires raw EC2 IMDS for non-AWS logic | Fargate is not suitable; use EC2 node group or external metadata proxy |
| App can run without IMDS | Proceed with Fargate |

### Gotchas — Phase 0

- **GovCloud model availability differs from commercial AWS.** Do not assume commercial Bedrock model IDs exist.
- **Mantle endpoint format is distinct:**
  ```text
  bedrock-mantle.<region>.api.aws/v1
  ```
  Do not accidentally use:
  ```text
  bedrock-runtime.<region>.amazonaws.com
  ```
- **Fargate has no EC2 IMDS.** A pod attempting `http://169.254.169.2
